data.one_liner: Flutter package for drawing over images with support for multiple paint modes and exporting.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter widget that lets users draw over images using various shapes like lines, rectangles, circles, arrows, freehand, and text. It features an integrated control bar, undo/clear functionality, and allows exporting the final drawing as image bytes.
use_when: You need a user to annotate or draw over network, asset, file, or memory images.
You want built-in paint tools and a control bar out of the box.
avoid_when: You only need to display images without any user drawing or annotation features.
You need advanced photo editing features like cropping or filters.
strengths: Supports multiple paint modes including lines, shapes, freehand, and text.
Provides constructors for network, asset, file, and memory images.
Built-in controller for exporting images and managing states.
weaknesses: Tested and working only on the Flutter stable channel.
Limited to basic drawing and text annotations over images.
